subject: Intro & quickstart: roadmap playbook for ClearMed pilot
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@clearmedhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & quickstart: roadmap playbook for ClearMed pilot

Hi Samir — great to meet you on Tuesday. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep timelines visible and align roles for the pilot. I’ve put a 30-day skeleton below and attached a one-sheet and a draft MAP we can iterate on.

High level goals (from our conversation):
- Validate Redwood inference latency and cost on your clinical summarization workload
- Run a 2-week eval with 3 clinical templates & representative prompt set
- Decide on pilot-to-prod criteria (latency p95, accuracy thresholds, cost per 1k tokens)

Proposed 30-day timeline (quickstart):
1) Week 0 (this week) — MAP review, stakeholder list, test data handoff
2) Week 1 — infra onboarding, model fingerprinting, initial eval runs
3) Week 2 — quality review, prompt tuning, cost calibration
4) Week 3 — final eval, decision meeting, next-steps for Dedicated/Private options

Requests / asks from ClearMed:
- Confirm champion and a proxy for legal/procurement (name + email)
- Share a small sample of de-identified prompts and expected outputs (SFTP/Drive link)
- Point person for infra/networking: cloud ops or security contact

Attachments: pilot-scope-one-pager.pdf (one-page) and ClearMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP)

I’ve invited Marissa (Customer Success) for onboarding ops and Jordan (AE lead) to support contract timing. If this looks good I’ll update the MAP with your stakeholder names and a firm calendar invite for the kickoff workshop.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-8123
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: ClearMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 12kb)
Attachment: pilot-scope-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 48kb)

From: Samir Rao <samir@clearmedhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@clearmedhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & quickstart: roadmap playbook for ClearMed pilot

Evelyn — thanks for the note and the clear plan. Priya will be our internal champion and I’ll be her backup for scheduling. Quick answers: 

- Champion: Priya Desai (Priya.Desai@clearmedhealth.com) — Clinical Data Lead
- Legal/procurement contact: Michael Turner (m.turner@clearmedhealth.com) — I’ll loop him in after we confirm the MAP
- Infra contact: Anjali Shah (anjali.shah@clearmedops.clearmed) — cloud ops

We can share a small de-identified prompt set via the secure drive link below by EOD Friday.

Also: for the decision meeting, we’d like an explicit checklist for go/no-go that includes: latency p95 target, failure rate tolerance, and an approximate monthly spend estimate. Can you include that in the MAP?

Thanks — Samir
Samir Rao
VP Product, ClearMed Health
samir@clearmedhealth.com

Subject: Re: Intro & quickstart: roadmap playbook for ClearMed pilot

Priya — thanks for stepping up as champion. I’ve updated the MAP (attached) with the go/no-go checklist you asked for and added timelines that map to your availability in the next three weeks. Quick notes on the checklist we added: 
- Latency p95: target <= 450ms on representative clinical prompts
- Failure / anomaly tolerance: < 1% of requests requiring manual retry during the eval window
- Cost estimate: baseline projection for 100k tokens/day (shown in MAP) with three quantization options 

Next steps I’ll take today:
- Add Michael Turner to the thread once Samir shares his email for procurement follow-up
- Create a shared secure Drive folder and drop the MAP + onboarding checklist
- Book a 60-minute kickoff workshop early next week (calendar invite pending)

If that sounds good I’ll lock the kickoff for Monday 10:00am PT; otherwise propose a slot.

Best — Evelyn
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: ClearMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with checklist)
